name: Shared Power [Metapsionic]
body:
You have learned to extend the range of your personal powers, granting their benefits to your nearby allies.

Benefit: To use this feat, you must expend your psionic focus. You can manifest a power with a range of personal at any distance up to 30 ft. as a ray, gaining no benefit yourself, but granting it to a willing target. You must succeed on a ranged touch attack for the target to be affected by the power or the power points are lost.

Alternatively, the power is treated as having the Network descriptor (see the spirit of many feature of the tactician and vitalist classes for mechanical information), rather than making a ranged touch attack.

Using this feat increases the power point cost of the power by 4. The power’s total cost cannot exceed your manifester level.
